text:
Hey guys!  We're planning to run OLake UI (v0.7.0) behind oauth2-proxy for Entra in our production environment. Three quick confirmations would help us commit without surprises:

  1. Does the UI use SSE or WebSockets for anything (live sync status, job
     progress, logs streaming)? Any specific endpoints we should allow explicit
     proxy pass-through for?

  2. Does the Go/Gin backend currently read any X-Forwarded-* or
     X-Auth-Request-* headers that oauth2-proxy injects? Any CSRF behavior
     tied to Origin/Referer we should know about?

  3. For the /bundle/import + /bundle/export endpoints (PR #338) — does the
     current implementation accept session-cookie auth only, or does it also
     support a static API key / token header for scripted callers behind an
     auth proxy?

  Thanks!
